name: @buildrail/core
description: BuildRail provider-neutral governance engine: config/state loading, schema validation, authorization policy, and the lifecycle transition engine.

scripts.clean: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true }); require('node:fs').rmSync('dist-tests', { recursive: true, force: true })"
